stages.title: Agree scope and owners
stages.purpose: Admit verified identities, review bounded owner eligibility and access, then name accountable people and scope.
stages.expected_result: Accountable ownership and an access plan. The local rehearsal does not verify live identity, grant access or prove deployment acceptance.

stages.title: Prepare a read-only connection
stages.purpose: Choose the provider and inspect the discovery/access boundary.
stages.expected_result: An adapter and permission review; no live connection is created.

stages.title: Check collection coverage
stages.purpose: Review permission limits, collection freshness and missing sources.
stages.expected_result: A retained collection/permission report before claiming coverage.

stages.title: Register protected capabilities
stages.purpose: Register services or standalone agents with clear owners and scope.
stages.expected_result: Canonical service or agent profiles; use either branch or both.

stages.title: Define the customer journey
stages.purpose: State the customer outcome and the steps that must succeed.
stages.expected_result: An ordered journey and accountable owner; draft planning stays local.

stages.title: Link shared resources
stages.purpose: Identify models, knowledge, tools, stores and runtime identities for each consumer.
stages.expected_result: Typed consumer links and separately reviewed content/access.

stages.title: Review dependencies and objectives
stages.purpose: Inspect service or agent reliance and define measurable task objectives.
stages.expected_result: A scoped dependency view, unresolved gaps and measurement definitions.

stages.title: Establish evidence and policies
stages.purpose: Review source provenance, expiry, access and policies. A live baseline requires a qualified accepted graph and completed verified projection.
stages.expected_result: Qualified evidence and an accepted projected graph for the Java workflow. UI examples do not import, qualify or accept evidence.

stages.title: Establish recovery baseline
stages.purpose: In Assess choose Place Order or Resolve Order, identify the example primary and fallback path, and enter the declared failure scenario and review reason.
stages.expected_result: A local baseline and first diagnostic review linked to the selected journey. The Java API instead requires authorized server records and a qualified projected graph; neither result certifies recovery.

stages.title: Plan a controlled recovery test
stages.purpose: Define a nonproduction scenario, expected effects, approval and stop conditions.
stages.expected_result: An approved test plan before a connected runtime can act.

stages.title: Validate and retain the result
stages.purpose: Review actual customer, application, data, security and agent outcomes after an independently authorized controlled test.
stages.expected_result: Retained actual test outcomes and independent review. Neither a local baseline nor a recorded reassessment supplies executed test evidence.

stages.title: Review changes and reassess
stages.purpose: Inspect pending changed context in Assess. Review shared dependencies, unrelated changes or expired evidence, record a reasoned reassessment when eligible, and agree any required retest.
stages.expected_result: Append-only review history and a current diagnostic view. Expired evidence blocks a new local review; refresh and qualify evidence before a real reassessment. Operating ownership, escalation and billing review remain handover tasks.

shared_resource_consumers: One or more services/agents; usage does not grant access.
menu_policy: Stable task groups; setup sequence belongs in the guide.

local_planning.bound_scope: Local prototype only; not a database journey-model limit.

stage_details: Expanded in the single graphical semantic list; standalone compact text alternative.

review_loop.title: Keep the baseline under review

steps.title: Inspect changed context
steps.detail: Identify the changed dependency or evidence and open its journey assessment.

steps.title: Refresh missing evidence
steps.detail: Expired or revoked evidence prevents reliance. Source qualification is a separate trusted process.

steps.title: Record reassessment
steps.detail: Select the journey, inspect the example change and enter a review reason. Retain earlier reviews.

steps.title: Agree controlled retest
steps.detail: Review findings and obtain the independent authority needed for a controlled test.

review_loop.boundary: REVIEW_REQUIRED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and NO_RELEVANT_CHANGE_OBSERVED are diagnostic states. Independence remains NOT_CERTIFIED; no automatic recovery is authorized.
